methodologyFootnote.title: What this dashboard can and can't show yet, and why
methodologyFootnote.paragraph1: PRD §13 commits CUE to shipping a metrics dashboard so Pico can verify its own claimed value independently, not take it on faith. Three of the ten §13 metrics are real, live numbers on this page: verification burden and write-back reply rate are computed here from the same commitment and write-back records you can inspect on each project's own Living WIP page; cost per project is read directly from the LLM usage ledger every extraction call writes to.
methodologyFootnote.paragraph2: The remaining seven are shown below with the specific, real reason they aren't measurable yet — a missing telemetry pipeline, a missing calendar integration, a schema decision nobody has made, or a ground-truth corpus that doesn't exist because Phase 0 discovery hasn't run. None of them are hidden, and none of them are a fabricated number. A chart with no data looks unfinished; a chart with a fabricated number looks finished and lies — this dashboard chooses the former every time.

coordinationOverhead.metric: Coordination overhead (PM minutes on relay activity)
coordinationOverhead.blocker: needs product-usage telemetry — no frontend usage-event pipeline exists anywhere in this codebase yet.

statusMeetingDuration.blocker: needs a calendar/Teams-meeting-duration integration — FR-CAP-13's transcript ingestion captures meeting content, not duration.

reportPreparationTime.blocker: needs a "WIP page opened" usage event — only the export half is timestamped today (ReportSnapshot.generated_at).

activeChatsPerPm.metric: Active chats per PM per day
activeChatsPerPm.blocker: needs product-usage telemetry for CUE's own UI — the same gap as coordination overhead above.

contingencyDrawn.blocker: Budget only carries approved_amount/currency — no contingency-vs-base split exists in the data model. This is a schema/product decision for Finance or a future backend session, not one this dashboard makes unilaterally.

captureRate.metric: Commitment capture rate (detected vs. ground truth)
captureRate.blocker: no real ground-truth corpus exists yet — Phase 0 discovery (PRD §15) hasn't run for any live project; cue-eval's ten synthetic cases are a regression smoke test, not an accuracy measurement.

extractionAccuracy.metric: Extraction accuracy by slice (language / channel / vendor category)
extractionAccuracy.blocker: drift-check results aren't persisted to a queryable table yet — only available via an offline cue-eval/run_eval.py --json run, not a live endpoint (re-running eval on every dashboard load was judged a design smell, not built).
